audit: Captain Underpants Maximum Aura v2 WC5 promotion audit

criteria.problem: A local score increase without direct branch reach would not identify WC5 as the cause.
criteria.evidence: The outcome-blind qualifier selected seed 20260733, slot 10, turn 1300 before scores were inspected. The matched candidate emitted one wc5 marker at that exact decision; control emitted zero.
criteria.practical_impact: Without fixed, outcome-blind reach, a favorable seed could be mistaken for policy improvement.
criteria.behavior_or_implementation_check: Exact v1 selected attack:p6laiyav:10 at 1.06x against a 0.05-share rival while Captain held 0.03. WC5 selected the accepted neutral boat boat:804503:8.
criteria.smallest_useful_fix: No source change. Preserve the exact candidate and carry this fixed seed and seat into the causal evidence.

criteria.problem: WC4 showed that the broad troop-ratio guard could suppress a profitable attack on a smaller rival.
criteria.evidence: The red-first 0.03-versus-0.02 fixture fails under WC4 and passes under WC5; WC5 remains deeply equal to exact v1 on that fixture.
criteria.practical_impact: Omitting territorial parity recreates the 266-tile WC4 collapse and weakens exact-v1 conversion against smaller rivals.
criteria.behavior_or_implementation_check: The only new behavioral boundary requires finite target tile share greater than or equal to Captain's finite tile share.
criteria.smallest_useful_fix: No broader rewrite. Retain the territorial-parity predicate as the sole WC5 correction.

criteria.problem: Accepted decisions can still conceal avoidable holds or degraded execution.
criteria.evidence: The matched pair recorded 2,248 accepted decisions, zero fallbacks, and zero degradation. Candidate field holds occurred at turns 7400, 7600, and 10100.
criteria.practical_impact: An avoidable no-op could erase the apparent gain or expose a controller defect that the score hides.
criteria.behavior_or_implementation_check: Every hold exposed only social, delete-unit, and hold actions. No tactical spawn, attack, boat, build, upgrade, or retreat was legal. Selected-seat unexplained holds are zero.
criteria.smallest_useful_fix: Classify and retain the three hold records in evidence; do not alter policy behavior to force a social action.

criteria.problem: An unbound or wrong-architecture image could invalidate the local comparison after upload.
criteria.evidence: The exact tested image is sha256:aa4b1f3acc57a74708d07c7c7aa546a7cd09dd53b0c181e3d9ae68575e331dc0, linux/amd64, user node, command node /app/llm-player.mjs. Its committed source hashes are recorded in the evidence packet.
criteria.practical_impact: Uploading a mutable tag or arm64 build would sever the link between the passing replay and the hosted policy.
criteria.behavior_or_implementation_check: Docker inspection and source hashing match the preregistered candidate commit 96482ba6595273e5b32be11c73a4907864f64933.
criteria.smallest_useful_fix: Upload only this immutable image ID under captain-underpants-max-aura:v2 and verify the returned policy-version identity.

criteria.problem: The one-seed local causal pair does not establish current-field or cross-map robustness.
criteria.evidence: No hosted diagnostic or independent 20-episode map-and-seat regression has run for WC5.
criteria.practical_impact: Submitting now could replace a known live policy with a candidate that only succeeds in one controlled World seat.
criteria.behavior_or_implementation_check: The preregistration and ProxyWar promotion doctrine require hosted 4/4 and separate 20/20 completion before submission.
criteria.smallest_useful_fix: Upload the exact image, run the frozen hosted 4/4, then run an independent 20/20 regression. Keep v1 live until both pass.

verdict.reason: Local causal and executable gates pass. Hosted and regression gates remain open.
